artistic_standard.visual_goal: Premium cinematic editorial photography that immediately stops scroll, visually authentic Spanish/Andalusian people, surreal architecture physically grounded, never generic AI stock
artistic_standard.unique_idea: Specific imaginative storytelling metaphor for the subject, not a stock house, floating papers, icon clutter or repeated glass spiral
artistic_standard.casting: Adult Spanish/Andalusian human protagonist(s), authentic local context and age variation, faces unobstructed; if requested adult woman+man actually show two adults with intended presentation; no tiny human silhouettes.

camera.shot_scale: Waist-up medium close-up; subjects dominate 55-70% height for social people-led scenes
camera.angle: Specify eye-level as default; choose deliberately low three-quarter view for empowerment or elevated for top-down still-life SEO only; justify any deviation by story
camera.lens: Choose one appropriate equivalent: 35mm environmental, 50mm natural cinematic, 85mm portrait; avoid wide-angle facial distortion
camera.aperture: f/2.8–f/4 as visual intent where both faces stay in focus; don't blur required props
camera.framing: Thirds and depth layers: human foreground, surreal sculpture in mid/background, authentic architectural context in far background; avoid cropping heads and hands

aspect_ratios.seo: landscape hero ratio determined by receiving URL; no overlays

lighting.source: Specify source and direction: Andalusian natural sunlight / large diffused window softbox; do not mix conflicting shadows
lighting.key: Soft key at about 30–45° from side, diffuse highlight on facial features with skin microtexture
lighting.fill: Subtle negative fill or diffuse bounce maintaining readable eyes, target visual key-to-fill ~2:1 to 4:1 not dark
lighting.rim: Optional subtle controlled golden rim/edge light separating subject from background
lighting.shadow: All human/object cast shadows coherent to one directional physical light source, realistic bounce and specular responses
lighting.contrast: Deep but readable blacks; luminous highlights with no clipping or muddy underexposure; skin midtones intact
lighting.time_of_day: Golden hour or bright Mediterranean morning depending narrative; don't make every slide identical

color_grade.dominant: Warm vivid Fénix orange #FF5F00 for artistic construction and highlights, not orange skin
color_grade.support: Honey golden #FFB71B accents, cream plaster, warm sandstone, charcoal where needed, restrained green plants as visual foil
color_grade.purple: Very little outside ORIGINAL untouched logo
color_grade.grading: Luxury cinematic color separation with restrained saturation, no flat corporate gradient, natural skin hues

artistic_standard.texture_and_materials: Photographic real human pores, hair strands, hands and clothing; cinematic tactile ceramic, brass, glass with refraction and plausible shadows; avoid beauty plastic or malformed hands
artistic_standard.surreal_direction: One hero art-installation metaphor per image, sculptural and bold, anchored in realistic location; never blocks faces, no fabricated financial approval marks, no paper or pseudo-letters
artistic_standard.typography: ALL model images have zero lettering/URLs/watermarks/labels; for social, 1 short bold Spanish hook composed separately in deterministic stage, legible with safe margins; for SEO, final image has no text or logo
artistic_standard.brand_compositing: Official Mr Bogart colored PNG/SVG original from immutable hash verified registry; choose by contrast; never request generative model to redraw or recolor it
artistic_standard.quality_threshold: No pass unless premium design, correct casting and context, no logos or invented pseudo-text, verified visual evidence, independent vision QA plus legal/brand gates

prompt_required_order: WHO: adult human subjects, roles, emotion and face scale, wardrobe without logos/letters
WHAT: specific action relating to user benefit and property/finance subject
WHERE: authentic Córdoba/Andalusia architectural and cultural context
CAMERA: chosen shot distance, eye-line angle, focal length, aperture/depth, thirds and layers
LIGHT: sunlight/window source, key direction/softness, fill/rim, shadow consistency
CONTRAST: dynamic range, subject visibility, bright blacks/whites control
COLOR: orange #FF5F00 campaign accent, gold #FFB71B, purple minimal, natural skin
SURREAL: bold unique physically integrated installation BEHIND faces with one clear narrative
QUALITY: real optical textures, correct anatomy, skin pores, hand count, material shading
POSTPROCESS: empty footer safe area 20-25% for social short hook and official logo
NEGATIVES: no logos, lettering, papers, emblems, watermarks, checks, bank approval claims, malformed people
variation_rules: Never reuse same model portrait, lens+light arrangement, architectural location and metaphor across adjacent slides
Use distinct role/age/setting/angle/story where editorial context supports it
Keep unified orange premium art identity without repeating identical generated compositions

after_completion_checks: original logo SHA-256, correct typographic fit, no overlaps
export layout, resolution and safe area
social source and destination publish gates

training_rule: Record exact prompt, scene, camera, light, contrast, color, QA violation, finished source hash, version, cost. A single successful image is evidence for that style, NOT permanent autonomous perfection.
